text: 交通银行副行长周万阜在交通银行2026年半年度业绩说明会上表示，从存款期限结构看，定期化趋势仍然没有明显的改变，存款的增量中大部分还是来自于定期存款。周万阜同时强调，交通银行今年的活期存款已实现同比多增，带动了整个存款成本下降。（上证报）
text_en: Zhou Wanfu, vice president of Bank of Communications, said at the bank's 2026 interim results briefing that in terms of deposit term structure, the trend toward fixed deposits remains largely unchanged, with most deposit growth still coming from time deposits. Zhou also stressed that BoCom's demand deposits have grown more year on year this year, helping lower overall deposit costs. (Shanghai Securities News)
